units.source_text: 听说棋手的性格大致有两类。

en.t: It is said that go players generally fall into two types of temperament.

units.source_text: 一类是同别人下棋时自己觉得能力不足型的，另一类是胸有成竹型的。

en.t: One type feels inadequate when playing against others, while the other type plays with confidence and a plan already in mind.

units.source_text: 如果大竹七段是前者，吴清源六段就是后者。

en.t: If Otake 7-dan was the former, then Wu Qingyuan 6-dan was the latter.
